subject: general
question: India is drafting its first comprehensive framework, National Adaptation Plan (NAP), to be submitted to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) by September 2025 in compliance with the _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris Agreement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's National Adaptation Plan (NAP)** is being drafted as the country’s first comprehensive framework for climate adaptation to address challenges posed by **climate change**.
 
• The **Paris Agreement**, adopted in **December 2015**, mandates signatory countries to submit their National Adaptation Plans (NAPs) to the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**.
 
• The Paris Agreement specifically aims to limit global temperature rise to **below 2°C above pre-industrial levels** and pursue efforts to limit the temperature increase to **1.5°C**.
 
• Under the Paris Agreement, countries are expected to focus not only on **mitigation** (reducing greenhouse gas emissions) but also on **adaptation** strategies to build resilience against climate impacts.
 
• India’s NAP is set to be submitted by **September 2025**, demonstrating India's compliance with its international climate commitments under the Paris Agreement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Paris Agreement:**

 
 
• The Paris Agreement is a landmark international treaty adopted during the **21st Conference of Parties (COP21)** in Paris, France.
 
• It involves commitments by **196 parties** to combat climate change and adapt to its effects, with enhanced support to assist developing countries.
 
• The agreement includes provisions for **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)**, where countries outline their climate actions and targets.
 
• It emphasizes global financial support for adaptation initiatives, especially in developing countries.
 
• The agreement entered into force on **4 November 2016**.
 
 
 
• **Cartagena Protocol:**
 
 
• Adopted in **2000** as a supplementary agreement to the **Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)**.
 
• Focuses on the safe handling, transport, and use of living modified organisms (LMOs) resulting from modern biotechnology.
 
• It does not address climate change but rather biodiversity and biosafety issues.
 
 
 
• **Kyoto Protocol:**
 
 
• Adopted in **1997**, it aimed to reduce greenhouse gas emissions globally, primarily focusing on industrialized nations.
 
• It set binding emission reduction targets but was replaced by the Paris Agreement as it failed to engage all nations equally.
 
 
 
• **Montreal Protocol:**
 
 
• Adopted in **1987**, this protocol focuses on protecting the ozone layer by phasing out ozone-depleting substances.
 
• It is not related to climate adaptation plans but is considered one of the most successful environmental treaties.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India’s Climate Commitments:**

 
 
• India submitted its **NDCs** under the Paris Agreement, pledging to reduce its emissions intensity of GDP by **33-35% by 2030** compared to 2005 levels.
 
• It also aims to achieve **40% of its electric power capacity** from non-fossil fuel sources by 2030.
 
 
 
• **National Adaptation Plan (NAP):**
 
 
• The NAP process is critical for developing countries to enhance resilience against climate impacts.
 
• It involves comprehensive research, stakeholder consultations, and policy framing to mitigate vulnerabilities.
 
 
 
• **UNFCCC:**
 
 
• The UNFCCC was established in **1992** to combat climate change and its impacts globally.
 
• The Paris Agreement operates under the framework of the UNFCCC.
